title: GearShare
desc: A community gear-sharing platform where neighbours can list equipment, form trusted groups, and manage borrow requests in real time. Features Firebase authentication, group-based access control, a RESTful Express API backed by PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM, Docker Compose for local development, and a CI/CD pipeline with automated test coverage.
tech: React 19, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Firebase Auth, Docker, Tailwind CSS

title: Dice Game (Strike)
desc: I built this so my husband and I could play our favorite dice game on road trips, with no ads. Roll five dice up to three times a turn and choose from 13 scoring categories. Built in React and playable live.

title: Spotify Favorites
desc: Pick a year and listen to the songs I had on repeat. A React app built around Spotify playlist embeds.
